text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong and how likely it is to happen. Once risks are clear, you need mitigation strategies to reduce their impact, such as training staff or improving security. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup actions you can take if a problem actually occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By reviewing your situation regularly, you can spot new dangers early and adjust your plans before small problems become serious ones.
